title: March 2026
summary: Planting season — the family found their shape.

scenes.prose: The father's silhouette settled first: black hair, a white fox tail, a deep blue hanbok with tassels that actually hang right.

asset.alt: A single pale-mint sprout, marking the first shape the fox father took.

scenes.prose: Four kits sketched in, each holding something — a scroll, a basket, a small hand reaching for a bigger one.

asset.alt: A sage-green leaf, marking the four kits gathered into one family group.

scenes.prose: The forest itself arrived last: lanterns, fireflies, a canopy heavy enough to hold real dark under it.

asset.alt: A wood-brown branch with three buds, marking the forest setting taking hold.
